votes.quote: Running them surfaced a real bug in `toCsv.ts`: `escapeCsv` wraps a value containing a `"` in quotes but never doubles the internal quote characters, so `say "hi"` produces `"say "hi""` instead of the spec's `"say ""hi"""`
